title: Gerunds
point: Use the -ing form after verbs like enjoy, mind, finish and avoid, after prepositions, and as the subject of a sentence.

sentences.ja: 休みの日は料理をするのが好きです。
sentences.text: I really enjoy cooking on my days off.
sentences.note: After "enjoy", always use -ing; "enjoy to cook" is wrong.

sentences.ja: 待つのは全然平気だよ。
sentences.text: I don't mind waiting at all.
sentences.note: "Mind" takes -ing; "I don't mind to wait" is wrong.

sentences.ja: ちょっと待ってもらってもいい？
sentences.text: Would you mind waiting a minute?

sentences.ja: レポートはもう書き終わった？
sentences.text: Have you finished writing your report yet?

sentences.ja: 朝のラッシュ時の電車は避けるようにしています。
sentences.text: I try to avoid taking the train during the morning rush.

sentences.ja: 誘ってくれてありがとう。
人前で話すのは得意じゃないんです。
sentences.text: I'm not very good at speaking in public.

sentences.ja: 近いうちに会えるのを楽しみにしています。
sentences.text: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon.
sentences.note: The "to" here is a preposition, so it takes -ing: not "to see".

sentences.ja: 毎日少しずつ単語を覚えるのが、語彙を増やす一番の方法です。
sentences.text: Learning a few words every day is the best way to build your vocabulary.

sentences.ja: 寝る前にスマホを見るのはやめたほうがいいよ。
sentences.text: You should stop looking at your phone before going to bed.
